name: memory_extract_entities
content: Extract structured entities from the following episodic memory data.

1. Read each episode carefully, prioritizing `memory_candidates`, `memory_updates`, final output excerpts, and the final outcome. Extract only durable entities that are likely to help future work: people, organizations, stable projects, reusable tools, stable preferences, workflows, and recurring patterns.
2. For each entity, extract its attributes and note which episodes mention it
3. Normalize entity names to their canonical form
4. Merge entities that refer to the same real-world thing across different episodes
5. Assign confidence scores based on evidence strength and consistency
6. Conform extracted entities to the target tier schema provided above

7. Do NOT extract transient trace debris: task IDs, execution IDs, one-off local test page URLs, temporary output filenames, internal helper names, or single-run implementation details unless the user explicitly asked to remember them or they describe a reusable environment/tool pattern.
8. Prefer fewer high-quality entities over exhaustive extraction. Skip low-value entities even if mentioned many times.

9. Respect each episode's `memory_quality.extraction_priority`: low-priority/progress-only episodes should contribute only when a durable fact is explicit in `memory_candidates`, `memory_updates`, or final output excerpts.
Return either a JSON object with an `entities` array matching the target schema, or a bare JSON array of entity objects if the model cannot safely wrap it. The runtime will normalize either shape.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no code blocks, no prose.

variables.name: source_json
variables.description: JSON-serialized array of episodic memory entries to extract entities from
examples: [{"id": "ep_001", "content": "User asked to schedule meeting with Alice", "timestamp": "2026-03-01T10:00:00Z"}]

variables.name: tier_schema
variables.description: JSON schema describing the target memory tier structure for extracted entities

variables.name: episode_count
variables.description: Number of episodes in the source data

metadata.description: User prompt instructing the LLM to extract structured entities from episodic memory data. Provides source episodes and target schema for entity conformance.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.1.0: Prioritizes memory_candidates, memory_updates, final output excerpts, and memory_quality extraction priority; rejects transient trace debris and prefers fewer high-quality durable entities. v1.0.0: Initial entity extraction user prompt for memory consolidation pipeline.
